prompt_policy: Reuse protocol-v1 prompts and frozen training demonstrations unchanged; isolate stopping and extraction changes.

stopping.completed_final_answer_line: Stop after the first Final answer: line receives a newline; do not stop while a numeric token prefix is incomplete.
stopping.next_question: Stop before a whitespace-delimited Question: or ### Question: marker in generated text, including inline markers.
stopping.eos: Use the pinned model EOS IDs; an answer ending at EOS may be parsed without a newline.
stopping.length: If a final-answer line ends at the token cap without a newline, EOS, or question boundary, classify it as incomplete; do not assume the last digit was complete.

normalization.numeric_equality: Exact rational equality. No rounding, tolerance, unit conversion, reference search, or arbitrary last-number extraction.

reporting.review: Always requires raw validation-output review. Passing alarms does not authorize a full benchmark automatically.
